name: 53565 · Mineral Point, WI
findings: ZIP 53565 (Mineral Point) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53565 (Mineral Point) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
